directional_replication: strictly more than 60 percent of confirmatory galaxies have D_g>0
hard_fail: any rank, covariance, support, provenance, or hash gate failure
any post-open change to fields, zones, masks, split, controls, or thresholds
decision_rule.individual_controls: the same exact shared-sign permutations form a studentized max-T null across radial-reversal, phase-rotation and cross-galaxy controls; all three adjusted p-values must be <0.05
decision_rule.look_accounting: this is one prevalidation look and cannot be called discovery at any p-value; a later Tau-specific discovery program must preregister a source-derived h_tau, all routes, alpha spending, and an independent survey/release replication
decision_rule.no_rescue: a failed one-shot confirmation may not be repaired with replacement galaxies, alternative masks, fewer sectors, different radial zones, or a new score in the same EDGE--CALIFA packet
decision_rule.primary_test: one-sided exact shared-sign permutation of mean(D_g)>0 over every 2^N confirmatory sign vector

deterministic_split.applied_after: historical exclusion and all source-only eligibility gates
deterministic_split.small_sample_boundary: the expected source-eligible cohort is small; v02 can only be prevalidation and cannot supply discovery or independent replication

external_data.resolution: matched 7 arcsec FWHM on a 3 arcsec CARMA grid
external_data.title: Data Tables for the CARMA Extragalactic Database for Galaxy Evolution (CARMA EDGE)

geometry_fields.angle_unit: degrees in the public table; converted once to radians

historical_overlap.known_result: 17 rotation-dominated galaxies were used for the published CO--Halpha rotation-curve comparison; about 75 percent had faster CO in the outer curve
historical_overlap.reason: their CO--Halpha terminal behavior and conventional eDIG interpretation are already public, so they are not untouched replication endpoints

interpretation.measurement_dependence_caveat: CO intensity and velocity share a data cube, and Halpha source and velocity fields share a spectral fit.  The frozen sector jackknife does not fully propagate this source--terminal covariance, so any pass requires a later end-to-end cube/mock audit.
interpretation.negative: failure of this frozen EDGE--CALIFA morphology-alignment proxy; it does not falsify the general Tau Core architecture
not_implied_by_positive: failure of standard astrophysics outside the declared nuisance span
Nature-level occupation of the Tau parent
interpretation.positive: source-developed external morphology-alignment prevalidation beyond the declared low-dimensional standard source span and equal-rank controls
interpretation.tau_specificity_blocker: the current test compares source-frozen spans but does not yet derive a unique coefficient map from the universal seed/body action; therefore even a pass is prevalidation rather than a beyond-standard Tau prediction
interpretation.v02_limit: source coverage and sector count were selected before terminal opening but after source inspection; a pass is therefore weaker than a fully untouched protocol

method_lineage.measurement_bridge_change: CALIFA/Pipe3D stellar mass replaces S4G 3.6um, and CARMA CO(1-0) replaces PHANGS CO(2-1); the five-zone harmonic algebra is retained
method_lineage.relationship: external operational homolog, not exact-instrument replication

projection_and_scores.cross_galaxy: [S_std,S_body(next galaxy in the sorted confirmatory list, cyclic)]
projection_and_scores.same_rank_requirement: correct and all three controls must each have combined stable rank 16 and projected covariance rank 4

scientific_question: After removing a declared conventional ionized-gas/eDIG source span, does the matched CO-minus-Halpha velocity contrast align more strongly with the frozen stellar-plus-CO morphology body than with equal-rank wrong-family bodies?
source_development_disclosure: v02 was selected after inspecting source-field coverage and ranks but before requesting either CO or Halpha velocity field; it is a new prevalidation look

body_columns: first radial difference of stellar m1
first radial difference of stellar m2
first radial difference of CO-intensity m1
first radial difference of CO-intensity m2
source_matrices.dispersion_caveat: Vdisp_sm includes instrumental width and is used only as a conservative standard-source nuisance descriptor, not as a calibrated intrinsic dispersion
source_matrices.embedding: real and imaginary profile parts enter only the matching m1 or m2 terminal coordinates; every 20-vector column is unit-normalized
source_matrices.profile_definition: normalized positive-field complex moment sum(w exp(i m theta))/sum(w) within each frozen radial zone
standard_columns: axisymmetric rotation-lag m1_cos profile constant across five zones
axisymmetric rotation-lag m1_cos profile linear in centered zone index
source_matrices.standard_span_boundary: the constant-plus-linear m1_cos columns explicitly absorb a smooth axisymmetric CO--Halpha rotation lag; the remaining six columns absorb declared eDIG/excitation and star-formation morphology, but this is not a complete standard-astrophysics model

explicitly_forbidden_during_source_freez: any published or recomputed CO-minus-Halpha velocity difference

source_support.azimuth_gate: all six fixed equal-width macrosectors occupied in every radial-edge zone
source_support.co_support: positive finite mom0_12 with positive finite e_mom0_12 inside the public dilated mask; no second integrated-SNR cut is imposed because the published mask already grows a two-channel 3.5-sigma seed to a 2-sigma boundary
source_support.profile_support: each source profile uses its own positive finite field support inside the frozen radial edges; standard nuisance fields are not forced onto the CO mask
source_support.radial_edge_support: intersection of CO, Halpha and stellar supports
source_support.radial_edges: five equal-count quantile zones from radial-edge support
source_support.why_six_sectors: source-only coverage showed that the inherited 12-sector PHANGS gate leaves only one nonhistorical EDGE galaxy; six sectors retain angular leave-one-sector variation while matching the public 7-arcsec beam on a sparse 3-arcsec grid

terminal_opening.covariance: delete-one-of-six-azimuth-macrosectors jackknife in each zone, assembled as five 4x4 blocks; every block and the 20x20 covariance must be full rank
terminal_opening.error_gate: both errors finite, positive, and <= 20 km/s
terminal_opening.support: intersection with the frozen v02 radial-edge support
terminal_opening.vector: 20 components ordered by five zones, with {m1_cos,m1_sin,m2_cos,m2_sin} in each zone
terminal_opening.zone_gate: at least 20 rows and all six macrosectors in each frozen zone
